titulo_es: Relating a struggle and its changes

texto: A biographical account presents an initial situation, important actions and its consequences. The time markers help to follow the order.
In a biography, the active voice stands out who acted; the passive voice stands out who or what happened to something. Choose the form according to what you want to highlight.
